scope: Mechanism-only synthetic single-view image pilot, NOT V9.3 first LA acquisition (no continuous 15mm/.5s/5-new-frame test). No real B-mode/contact/QP.

private_to_simulator: held-out target lane and tangent mode
prohibited: hidden target truth in planner/commanded nominal velocity

template.body_status: synthetic generic chart, not a patient scan

latent.decoy: opposite lane, opposite nominal tangent, fixed within-world curve

primitive.nominal_twist: derivative of commanded DMP pose only
primitive.speed_contract: DMP segment duration from peak sampled translational and angular step, guaranteeing <=0.02m/s and <=0.5rad/s nominal; no actual QP claim

sensor.model_likelihood: nominal four-mode Gaussian/Beta mixture; continuous public features, no discretization for posterior

quality.contract: single-frame pilot proxy only; V9.3 LA 15mm/2mm/10deg/.5s/5 new frames remains untested

planning.quadrature: fixed public model samples: missing plus visible standardized u/tangent offsets (-1,0,+1) and beta quantiles (0.2,0.8), weighted by latent and probabilities; no result-adaptive samples
planning.controller_compute_cost: actual planner wall seconds charged to episode; identical max 2 action and 2 observation budget
planning.capability_proxy: shared speed/endpoint-box gate only; no actual QP claim, B_no_capability_proxy ablation may be null

evaluation.information_causality: two hidden worlds with same public prior/observation prefix yield identical belief/action/internal state until observation differs
evaluation.primary_metric: pilot_single_frame_quality_rate; not first qualified LA rate
evaluation.paired_prior_sensitivity: same public observation prefix and robot state; compare altered legal prior mode weights, not hidden truth
evaluation.time_basis: V9.3-inspired 60s censored pilot time; does not imply LA contract

limitations: no actual bottom QP in this isolated benchmark
no learned A response within this first mechanism unless added before results
